notablePrerequisites:
Journey to the Oracle.You control at least eight lands.
You control at least five basic lands, two of which must be Forests.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate all basic lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{G}.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a basic land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it and giving it hexproof until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 for each remaining basic land you control.
Cast Journey to the Oracle by paying {2}{G}{G}, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding a card to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
The lands enter the battlefield, triggering Omnath that many times, causing you to draw that many cards and put that many +1/+1 counters on an Elemental you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
